description:
Every state-changing mutation needs a visible failure outcome and a retry that actually re-issues the write. Researched 2026-09-12; decisions locked; ready to execute. CORRECTIONS TO THIS TICKET'S ORIGINAL TEXT (verified against the code): - ProgramScreen has 12 useMutation declarations, NOT 13 (lines 72-135, contiguous block). None has onError. The file does not import ErrorBanner or errorMessage at all. - BodyScreen has 1 declaration, NOT 2 (BodyScreen.tsx:42). It lives inside MetricCard, which renders 3x from the METRICS array (:20-24, :107-109), so 3 instances at runtime. "2" matched neither number - stale from when METRICS had two entries. - SessionDetailScreen already renders a banner for all 3 mutations. The work there is fixing quality, not adding it. - The ticket cited "RULES 7". The governing rule is RULES.md #8 ("Every state-changing mutation has a visible pending, success, and failure outcome... A retry belongs next to the failure, not in a reload"). #7 is the adjacent workout-loop rule. === DECISIONS (settled with the user, do not re-litigate) === 1. EXTRACT A SHARED HOOK, do not copy the pattern a third time. RULES.md #9: "Deduplicate the moment a second copy exists." SessionScreen and FuelPanel are already two verbatim copies - 7 onError closures plus duplicated state/render lines. Adopt the hook in all five screens including SessionScreen and FuelPanel. 2. HIDE RETRY ON 4xx. Read ApiError.status (apps/web/src/lib/api/errors.ts:2-11) and omit the Retry button for 400-499 except 408 and 429. Network failures and 5xx keep Retry. Today a 422 and a dropped connection render an identical retryable banner because errorMessage() (:14-17) flattens everything to a string and status is never read anywhere in apps/web/src. 3. BODYSCREEN BANNER IS PER-CARD, inside MetricCard after the .bm-log row (after :85) and before the LineChart. The error sits next to the button that failed and each metric reports independently. No state lifting. === API SHAPE - IMPORTANT TS CONSTRAINT === The obvious shape `onError: onErrorFor(() => updateEx)` risks a TypeScript circular-inference error: updateEx's type would depend on its own initializer and resolve to implicit any. CLAUDE.md forbids any and casts, so do NOT use that shape. Use two hooks instead, with the self-reference hidden behind an internal ref: const errors = useMutationError(); // shared banner state for the screen const updateEx = useTrackedMutation(errors, { mutationFn, onSuccess }); useTrackedMutation calls useMutation, holds the result in a ref, and injects its own onError: onError: (err, vars) => errors.report(err, () => ref.current?.mutate(vars)) and wraps onSuccess to clear first. Named as a hook so the react-hooks lint rule is satisfied. No circularity, no any, no cast. useMutationError owns: the {message, retry?} state, a clear(), a report(err, retry), and the retryability check. retry is undefined when isRetryableError(err) is false, which is what suppresses the button (ErrorBanner already treats onRetry as optional). Add isRetryableError(err: unknown): boolean to apps/web/src/lib/api/errors.ts. A non-ApiError (fetch rejects with a plain TypeError before ApiError is ever constructed - client.ts:39) is retryable; 5xx retryable; 4xx not, except 408/429. === WHY onError(err, vars) IS THE ONLY WORKABLE RETRY === Roughly half the call sites are inside flatMap/map closures over server data, or read onBlur DOM values discarded immediately after. The failed variables are unreachable from the banner's render position. Capturing vars in onError works uniformly for all of them without touching a single call site. Evidence: - ProgramScreen updateEx (:120) has 15 call sites, all inside the selDay.exercises.flatMap() at :302-436. - renameDay (:87) and updateDay (:116) read e.target.value on blur from uncontrolled defaultValue inputs - the value is gone afterward. - reorderDays (:98) and reorderEx (:131) take a computed array built in moveDay() (:168-175) / moveEx() (:176-182). - addExercise (:102) call sites at :458 and :466 both setAddEx("") immediately after firing. - SessionDetailScreen editSet/deleteSet call sites (:236-237) are inside data.exercises.map() -> e.sets.map(). This is also exactly why removeSession is the only working retry on SessionDetailScreen: data.id happens to be in scope where the banner renders (:191-193). === TWO REAL BUGS IN SessionDetailScreen (not known when this ticket was filed) === apps/web/src/screens/history/SessionDetailScreen.tsx:184-186 {(editSet.isError || deleteSet.isError) && ( invalidateSets()} /> )} (a) THE RETRY BUTTON IS DEAD. invalidateSets() only refetches queries; it never re-issues the failed PATCH/DELETE. isError stays true so the banner does not even dismiss - the button reads as inert while the write stays lost. (b) WRONG ERROR CAN DISPLAY. editSet.error ?? deleteSet.error always prefers editSet, so a failed delete following an earlier failed edit shows the stale edit message. Neither mutation is ever reset. Both have the same root cause: no onError(err, vars), so the failed variables are never captured. Adopting the hook fixes both. === PATTERN TO EXTRACT FROM === apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:124 (state), :479 (render), :192-206 and :207-216 (onError closures), :140-150 (reset effect keyed on targetKey), :126-132 + :191 (createdSessionId ref - retry-specific bookkeeping so a logSet retry does not re-create the session; the generic hook must not break this). apps/web/src/screens/start/FuelPanel.tsx:35, :123, :50-52, :60-62, :72-74 - verbatim duplicate, and MISSING the reset effect, so a stale banner can persist. Adopting the hook fixes that too. apps/web/src/components/ErrorBanner.tsx:1-12 - takes {message, onRetry?}, role="alert", renders .eb-retry only when onRetry is present. No change needed. CSS apps/web/src/styles/theme.css:2684-2714. Note the scoped one-off .eating .error-banner { margin-bottom: 16px } at :928-930. apps/web/src/lib/query/query-client.ts - retry: 1 is queries-only; mutations get TanStack's default retry: 0, so manual retry is the only retry. === BANNER MOUNT POINTS === ProgramScreen has TWO render paths. Main: after of .view-head at :206, matching SessionScreen (:479) and FuelPanel (:123). But the !program early return at :139-161 is a separate subtree containing createProgram's call sites (:154, :156) and needs its own banner inside
around :149. Missing this is the easy mistake. Width note: .day-chips and .pex-ctl already wrap at the 390px budget, so a full-width banner after .view-head pushes the editor down rather than competing horizontally. That is fine. BodyScreen: per-card, per decision 3. SessionDetailScreen: the existing :184 slot is already correct; it just needs real onError closures behind it. === SCOPE === 5 screens, 12 + 3 + 3 + 4 + 3 = 25 mutations total. ProgramScreen's 12 declarations are one contiguous edit (:72-135). Also worth fixing while there: addExercise's mutationFn (:103-108) is an unguarded two-step async - if POST /api/exercises fails, the second POST never runs and the whole mutation rejects. With onError in place this finally surfaces. === VERIFY === pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint clean, no any / no casts / no non-null assertions introduced by the hook. Manually: stop the API (docker compose stop or kill the dev server), then on each screen trigger a write - banner appears with Retry; restart the API and tap Retry; the write lands and the banner clears. 4xx path: create a program with a duplicate name (or any 409/422 route) - message shows with NO Retry button. SessionDetailScreen: fail an edit, then fail a delete - the delete's message shows, not the stale edit message. ProgramScreen empty state: with no program at all, fail createProgram - the banner appears inside the empty state, not offscreen. BodyScreen: fail one metric's log - only that card shows a banner, the other two are unaffected. SessionScreen regression: fail a logSet on a session that does not exist yet, retry, and confirm exactly one session is created (the createdSessionId ref at :126-132 still does its job). RELATED: ISS-007. Its "superset edits do not stick" report has three candidate causes and one of them IS this ticket - ProgramScreen's silent PATCH failure leaves the uncontrolled .pex-tag-in input showing the new value with nothing reported, so it reads as saved until a reload. Do T-001 first, then re-test ISS-007; it may shrink to a sizing fix.
title: Surface failure and retry on every mutation
